mapper.select: SELECT match_id AS matchId, field_name AS fieldName, highlight_video AS highlightVideo, match_at AS matchAt, created_at AS createdAt, match_level AS matchLevel, gender, num_members AS numMembers, status FROM matches ORDER BY match_id DESC

SELECT match_id AS matchId, field_name AS fieldName, highlight_video AS highlightVideo, match_at AS matchAt, created_at AS createdAt, match_level AS matchLevel, gender, num_members AS numMembers FROM matches
AND match_at >= SYSDATE
AND gender = '${isGender}'
AND match_level = ${level}
AND TRUNC(match_at) = TO_DATE('${date}', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM match_at) BETWEEN 18 AND 23
ORDER BY match_at ASC, match_id DESC

SELECT m.match_id AS matchId, m.field_name AS fieldName, m.highlight_video AS highlightVideo, m.match_at AS matchAt, m.created_at AS createdAt, m.match_level AS matchLevel, m.gender, m.num_members AS numMembers, g.address, g.address_detail AS addressDetail, g.region, g.size_info AS sizeInfo, g.is_indoor AS isIndoor, g.grass_type AS grassType, g.parking_type AS parkingType, g.has_shower AS hasShower, g.has_lights AS hasLights, g.has_shoes_rental AS hasShoesRental, g.has_ball_rental AS hasBallRental, g.price_per_hour AS pricePerHour, g.notice FROM matches m LEFT JOIN ground g ON m.field_name = g.name WHERE m.match_id = ${matchId}
